preconditions.description: The number of operators is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line) <= 20 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each operator is a non-empty line of no more than 20 lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all('*' not in B and '&' not in B for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.startswith('typedef'))
preconditions.description: In typedef operations, B does not contain asterisks or ampersands.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output_line, str) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line of the output is a string.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == sum(1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.startswith('typeof'))
postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of typeof operations.
